detail.title: Synthesis of Intrinsic Curiosity and Multi-Agent Evolution for Autonomous Inquiry
detail.summary: This cycle incorporates foundational developmental evidence on curiosity-driven learning alongside recent empirical multi-agent scientific discovery frameworks, illustrating how intrinsic exploration mechanisms complement structured multi-agent collaboration for autonomous problem formulation.
